plugin.name: Workspace
plugin.description: Opens a project's repository or files in an editor and its pages in the browser, from resources bound on this computer.

dependencies.projects: Open project workspace opens the active project's resources; without Projects there is no active project.

permissions.resources: Opens the folders and files you bound on this computer in the editor you bound, and a project's pages in the browser, when you press a key.
permissions.openUrl: Opens the web pages you typed into an Open pages action in the browser, when you press a key.
permissions.profile: Reads the active project's key to report which project was opened.

open-in-editor.name: Open in editor
open-in-editor.description: Opens the project's repository, or a file bound on this computer at a line, in an editor.

open-urls.name: Open pages
open-urls.description: Opens up to ten web pages (http, https) in the default browser.

open-project.name: Open project workspace
open-project.description: Opens the current project's repository in its editor, its documentation and other pages, from the project's resources. Missing ones are reported.

application.label: Editor
application.description: An application resource: the editor (bind its command-line tool, e.g. /usr/local/bin/code, to open at a line in an editor that is already running on macOS).

editor.label: Editor kind
editor.description: How to pass a line: vscode and cursor (--goto file:line), jetbrains (--line N file), zed and sublime (file:line). other opens the file without a line.

location.label: Folder or file
location.description: A folder or file resource. Empty: the project's repository.

path.label: File
path.description: Not supported by the plugin yet: bind the file as a resource and choose it as Folder or file.

urls.label: Pages
urls.description: One http or https address per line, at most 10.

browser.label: Browser
browser.description: An application resource. Pages open in the default browser for now.

editorRole.label: Editor resource
editorRole.description: The project resource that is the editor (an application).

repositoryRole.label: Repository resource
repositoryRole.description: The project resource that is the repository (a folder). Empty: skip.

docsRole.label: Documentation resource
docsRole.description: A page (URL) or folder. Empty: skip.

urlRoles.label: Other pages
urlRoles.description: Project resources that are pages, one name per line, e.g. dashboard, at most 10.

errors.invalid-position: A line or column is out of range, or given without a file.
errors.too-many-urls: More pages than can be opened at once.
errors.nothing-opened: Nothing of the project could be opened.
errors.path-not-supported: A file inside a folder cannot be opened by the plugin yet.

messages.line-needs-file: a line needs a file, not a folder
messages.position-range: a line and column are from 1 to 1000000
messages.path-not-supported: a file inside a folder cannot be opened yet: bind the file as a resource and choose it as the folder or file
messages.too-many-urls: at most 10 pages can be opened at once
messages.not-web: “{{url}}” must be an http or https address
messages.opened-pages-failed: opened {{count}} pages; {{failed}} could not be opened
